description: OpenCode application telemetry, scoped exactly to cloud_RoleName == "opencode". Select an Application Insights resource. SDK operations, explicit prompt events, tool spans, and other instrumentation are separate populations. Both classic and native OTLP component compatibility views are supported; missing usage, outcomes, and exception text remain unknown. See coverage panels and descriptions for limitations.

panels.description: Distinct non-empty session IDs observed in application-scoped spans and logs during the selected window. A session is counted once across both signals. This is observed activity, not sessions created; missing IDs and process/run IDs are not sessions.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
union
(dependencies | where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode" | project sessionId = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["ai.telemetry.metadata.sessionId"]), tostring(customDimensions["session.id"]))),
(traces | where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode" | project sessionId = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["ai.telemetry.metadata.sessionId"]), tostring(customDimensions["session.id"])))
| where isnotempty(sessionId)
| summarize by sessionId
| summarize sessions = count()

panels.title: Observed Sessions

panels.description: Count of explicit user_prompt log events from OpenCode telemetry hooks. This signal covers only instrumented sessions; it is not interchangeable with SessionPrompt.prompt spans or all AI SDK operations.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
traces | where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
| where tostring(customDimensions["event.name"]) == "user_prompt"
| summarize prompts = count()

panels.title: User Prompt Events

panels.description: Number of ai.streamText SDK operation spans, including failed operations. Excludes nested ai.streamText.doStream attempts and separate opencode.llm telemetry. This is not a count of HTTP retries or user prompts.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
| where name == "ai.streamText"
| summarize llmCalls = count()

panels.title: LLM Calls

panels.description: Reported ai.usage.totalTokens on ai.streamText operations only. Missing or inconsistent usage is excluded, not zero consumption. See Token Reporting % and LLM Usage Coverage. Child doStream spans and opencode.llm observations are not added.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
| where name == "ai.streamText"
| extend input = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.inputTokens"]),
         output = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.outputTokens"]),
         total = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.totalTokens"]),
         cacheRead = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.inputTokenDetails.cacheReadTokens"]),
         cacheWrite = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.inputTokenDetails.cacheWriteTokens"])
| extend validUsage = isnotnull(total) and isnotnull(input) and isnotnull(output) and input >= 0 and output >= 0 and total == input + output
| summarize totalTokens = sumif(total, validUsage), reported = countif(validUsage)
| project totalTokens = iff(reported > 0, totalTokens, real(null))

panels.title: Reported Tokens

panels.description: Cache-read tokens divided by input tokens on the same ai.streamText operations with valid cache-read and positive input measurements. Cached input is already included in total input. Missing measurements are excluded.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
| where name == "ai.streamText"
| extend input = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.inputTokens"]),
         output = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.outputTokens"]),
         total = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.totalTokens"]),
         cacheRead = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.inputTokenDetails.cacheReadTokens"]),
         cacheWrite = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.inputTokenDetails.cacheWriteTokens"])
| where input > 0 and isnotnull(cacheRead) and cacheRead >= 0 and cacheRead <= input
| summarize cached = sum(cacheRead), input = sum(input)
| project pct = iff(input > 0, 100.0 * cached / input, real(null))

panels.title: Cache Read %

panels.description: Exception telemetry records for opencode, not distinct failed operations. Ingestion paths may retain different exception events; native exception text can be absent.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
exceptions | where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
| summarize exceptions = count()

panels.title: Exception Records

panels.description: Count of Tool.execute spans only. Excludes ai.toolCall wrappers and separate opencode.tool.* observations to avoid mixing populations.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
| where name == "Tool.execute"
| summarize toolCalls = count()

panels.title: Tool Executions

panels.description: Failed Tool.execute spans divided by spans with a known success flag. Uses the component compatibility-view success field, which is present on both ingestion paths. Missing outcomes are excluded; see the tool table unknown column.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
| where name == "Tool.execute"
| summarize failed = countif(success == false), known = countif(isnotnull(success))
| project pct = iff(known > 0, 100.0 * failed / known, real(null))

panels.title: Tool Failure %

panels.description: Share of ai.streamText operations reporting non-negative input/output and a matching total token count. Includes failed operations in the denominator. Missing usage is unknown, not zero. Replaces the invalid ratio of SDK tokens to a different prompt-span population.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
| where name == "ai.streamText"
| extend input = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.inputTokens"]),
         output = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.outputTokens"]),
         total = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.totalTokens"]),
         cacheRead = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.inputTokenDetails.cacheReadTokens"]),
         cacheWrite = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.inputTokenDetails.cacheWriteTokens"])
| extend validUsage = isnotnull(total) and isnotnull(input) and isnotnull(output) and input >= 0 and output >= 0 and total == input + output
| summarize calls = count(), reported = countif(validUsage)
| project pct = iff(calls > 0, 100.0 * reported / calls, real(null))

panels.title: Token Reporting %

panels.description: p95 duration of completed SessionPrompt.prompt spans, converted from milliseconds to seconds. Covers this span population only, not every user_prompt event or session. Spans include tool/agent work and may be long; not model time-to-first-token.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
| where name == "SessionPrompt.prompt"
| summarize p95s = percentile(duration, 95) / 1000.0

panels.title: Prompt Span p95

panels.description: Average output tokens among ai.streamText operations with a reported non-negative output count. Missing measurements are excluded, not counted as zero.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
| where name == "ai.streamText"
| extend output = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.outputTokens"])
| where isnotnull(output) and output >= 0
| summarize avgOut = avg(output)

panels.title: Avg Reported Output / Call

panels.description: Cache-write tokens divided by input tokens on the same operations reporting valid cache-write measurements. Models without this attribute are excluded, not assigned zero. See per-model reporting coverage.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
| where name == "ai.streamText"
| extend input = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.inputTokens"]),
         output = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.outputTokens"]),
         total = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.totalTokens"]),
         cacheRead = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.inputTokenDetails.cacheReadTokens"]),

| where input > 0 and isnotnull(cacheWrite) and cacheWrite >= 0 and cacheWrite <= input

panels.title: Cache Write % (Reported)

panels.description: Count of ai.streamText operations per dynamic time bin, stacked by reported model. Counts are not a per-second rate.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
| where name == "ai.streamText"
| extend model = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["ai.model.id"]), "(not reported)")
| summarize calls = count() by bin(timestamp, $__interval), model
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: LLM Calls by Model

panels.description: Disjoint stack for operations with valid token and cache-read measurements: other input (including cache writes), cache-read input, and output. Cache-read is a subset of input, so total input is not stacked again. Missing usage is omitted.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
| where name == "ai.streamText"
| extend input = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.inputTokens"]),
         output = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.outputTokens"]),
         total = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.totalTokens"]),
         cacheRead = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.inputTokenDetails.cacheReadTokens"]),
         cacheWrite = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.inputTokenDetails.cacheWriteTokens"])
| extend validUsage = isnotnull(total) and isnotnull(input) and isnotnull(output) and input >= 0 and output >= 0 and total == input + output
| where validUsage and isnotnull(cacheRead) and cacheRead >= 0 and cacheRead <= input
| summarize otherInput = sum(input - cacheRead), cacheRead = sum(cacheRead), output = sum(output) by bin(timestamp, $__interval)
| order by timestamp asc

panels.title: Token Usage Over Time

panels.description: Top 30 tools by Tool.execute span count. Failures use the normalized success flag; unknown counts missing outcomes. Total duration sums individual executions and is not wall-clock elapsed time.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
| where name == "Tool.execute"
| extend toolName = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["tool.name"]), "(not reported)")
| summarize calls = count(), failures = countif(success == false), unknown = countif(isnull(success)),
            totalSec = round(sum(duration) / 1000.0, 2), p95ms = percentile(duration, 95) by toolName
| order by calls desc, toolName asc
| take 30

panels.title: Top Tools Called

panels.description: Top 20 destinations for all instrumented HTTP client spans, including metadata/model requests; not exclusively WebFetch. Handles native HTTP spans and classic http.client spans. Uses valid HTTP status attributes first, then valid resultCode; other includes unknown and 1xx.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies | where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
| where type =~ "http" or name startswith "http.client"
| extend hostRaw = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["server.address"]), tostring(parse_url(data).Host), target),
         attributeStatus = toint(customDimensions["http.response.status_code"]), resultStatus = toint(resultCode)
| extend host = coalesce(tostring(parse_url(iff(hostRaw contains "://", hostRaw, strcat("https://", hostRaw))).Host), "(not reported)"),
         status = case(attributeStatus between (100 .. 599), attributeStatus, resultStatus between (100 .. 599), resultStatus, int(null))
| summarize calls = count(), s2xx = countif(status between (200 .. 299)), s3xx = countif(status between (300 .. 399)),
            s4xx = countif(status between (400 .. 499)), s5xx = countif(status between (500 .. 599)),
            other = countif(isnull(status) or status < 200) by host
| order by calls desc, host asc
| take 20

panels.title: HTTP Destinations

panels.description: ai.streamText operation durations in milliseconds, including streaming and any nested tool work. Not first-token or single-network-request latency. Both p50 and p95 are shown.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
| where name == "ai.streamText"
| extend model = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["ai.model.id"]), "(not reported)")
| summarize calls = count(), failures = countif(success == false), p50ms = percentile(duration, 50), p95ms = percentile(duration, 95) by model
| order by calls desc

panels.description: Top 10 non-empty SDK session IDs by reported valid ai.streamText tokens. Unreported usage is unknown; reported counts operations with valid usage. Sessions without an ID are excluded.

dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
| where name == "ai.streamText"
| extend input = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.inputTokens"]),
         output = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.outputTokens"]),

         cacheRead = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.inputTokenDetails.cacheReadTokens"]),

panels.description: Top exception groups by full exported outer message and type; display text is limited to 160 characters. Native OTLP can omit outerMessage. Missing text is marked explicitly, not reconstructed.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
exceptions | where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
| extend errType = coalesce(type, "(not reported)"), fullMessage = outerMessage
| summarize calls = count() by errType, fullMessage
| order by calls desc, errType asc
| take 10
| project errType, calls, msg = iff(isempty(fullMessage), "(message not exported)", substring(fullMessage, 0, 160))

panels.description: Token-weighted cache-read input share for operations reporting valid cache-read and input measurements. Not the percentage of requests with a cache hit.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
| where name == "ai.streamText"
| extend input = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.inputTokens"]),
         output = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.outputTokens"]),

panels.title: LLM Outcomes Over Time

panels.description: Per-model ai.streamText coverage. Usage requires consistent non-negative input/output/total. Cache-write requires a valid measured cache-write value, including explicit zero; absent is not zero. Last call is the latest span start, not ingestion time.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
dependencies
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
| where name == "ai.streamText"
| extend model = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["ai.model.id"]), "(not reported)")
| extend input = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.inputTokens"]),
         output = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.outputTokens"]),
         total = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.totalTokens"]),
         cacheRead = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.inputTokenDetails.cacheReadTokens"]),
         cacheWrite = todouble(customDimensions["ai.usage.inputTokenDetails.cacheWriteTokens"])
| extend validUsage = isnotnull(total) and isnotnull(input) and isnotnull(output) and input >= 0 and output >= 0 and total == input + output
| extend sessionId = coalesce(tostring(customDimensions["ai.telemetry.metadata.sessionId"]), tostring(customDimensions["session.id"]))
| summarize calls = count(), reported = countif(validUsage),
            writeReported = countif(isnotnull(cacheWrite) and input >= 0 and cacheWrite >= 0 and cacheWrite <= input),
            sessionReported = countif(isnotempty(sessionId)), lastCall = max(timestamp) by model
| project model, calls, usagePct = 100.0 * reported / calls, cacheWritePct = 100.0 * writeReported / calls,
          sessionPct = 100.0 * sessionReported / calls, lastCall
| order by calls desc

panels.title: LLM Usage Coverage

panels.description: Separate signal populations: do not add parent/child spans, event reports, and metric observations as operations. Latest timestamp is event time, not ingestion time. Metric exports can repeat old cumulative values, so fresh metric timestamps do not prove new user activity. A zero metric observation count explicitly indicates no metric records at this resource in the selected window.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
union
(dependencies | where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
 | where name in ("ai.streamText", "ai.streamText.doStream", "ai.toolCall", "Tool.execute", "SessionPrompt.prompt", "opencode.llm", "opencode.session")
 | summarize records = count(), lastSeen = max(timestamp) by signal = name
 | extend source = "Spans"),
(traces | where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
 | extend signal = tostring(customDimensions["event.name"])
 | where isnotempty(signal)
 | summarize records = count(), lastSeen = max(timestamp) by signal
 | extend source = "Log events"),
(customMetrics | where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where cloud_RoleName == "opencode"
 | summarize records = count(), lastSeen = max(timestamp)
 | extend source = "Metrics", signal = "Exported observations (not operations)")
| project source, signal, records, lastSeen
| order by source asc, records desc
